visual_description: A slender, high-carbon steel chisel designed for precision. Unlike the flat-head version, this tool tapers to a sharp, four-sided pyramid point. The shaft is hexagonal for a steady grip, and the striking cap shows slight mushrooming from field use. It features a bright yellow rubber hand guard for knuckle protection.

constraints.material: Brushed industrial steel; high-visibility yellow rubber.
constraints.background: Isolated on a neutral 50% grey studio floor with high-contrast contact shadows.
